text:
Carol: Quick Q — we're planning to flip default model pin behavior for hosted API on 2025-07-15. Confirm deprecation timeline and SDK expectations? @Mike @Alex
Mike: Keep 60-day deprecation window. Post 30-day reminder. Add in-response header when callers use the old default. SDKs should still work but prefer explicit pinning. :+1:
Alex: Plan:
- Day 0: announce + console banner
- Day 30: responses include `X-Model-Deprecation: will-remove-in-30d`
- Day 60: unpinned requests route to `latest-stable` (was legacy default)
Sam: For SDKs, do we auto-insert `model: "latest-stable"` for unpinned calls or just warn? mobile releases slow.
Mike: Avoid auto-mutation. SDKs surface a runtime warning and expose helpers: `Client.warnOnUnpinned = true` and `Client.pinTo('latest-stable')`.
Rachel: If latest-stable is at capacity, what's the fallback? We don't want sudden routing to worse models.
Alex: Fallback chain: `latest-stable` -> pinned-compat -> regional-variant -> graceful-queue. Emit `X-Model-Fallback: <model-id>` header on fallback.
Carol: Response contract risk: latest-stable could change response shape/tokenization.
Jen: Any model promoted to latest-stable must pass regression suite (prompt tests, token counts, response schema). If schema changes we add `X-Response-Schema: v2` and keep compatibility shim for two release cycles.
Mike: Comms: blog post + console banner + API header + email to customers with >10k tokens/month and using unpinned requests. Deprecation page with migration steps.
Carol: Can someone draft header examples and SDK log message? I'll send to Product for banner copy.
Sam: Draft SDK log: `console.warn("Redwood: default model pin removed on 2025-07-15. Pin a model or call Client.pinTo('latest-stable')")`
Alex: Header samples:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Model-Deprecation: will-remove-in-30d
X-Model-Fallback: redwood-v1-quantized
X-Response-Schema: v1
and when unpinned but routed to latest:
X-Model-In-Use: latest-stable (was: unpinned)
Rachel: Dev diagnostics opt-in JSON field suggestion: `{"_redwood": {"model_in_use": "latest-stable","fallback": "regional-variant"}}` non-prod only.
Mike: Opt-in via `?dev_diagnostics=true` or `X-Diagnostics: true` header.
Carol: Next steps:
- Alex: PR w/ header names + fallback chain (owner: Alex, due EOD)
- Jen: add regression gating checklist to model onboarding (owner: Jen, due 48h)
- Mike: comms plan + customer list (owner: Mike, due 72h)
- SDK owners: add runtime warning + helper API (sync with Sam)
I'll open the ticket and link this thread. Thanks! :rocket:
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: announcer-service v2.3.0 -> staging at 2025-03-12T14:00Z
Alex: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/462
Sam: Mobile SDK patch started; may take ~1 week due to freeze.
Jen: Gating checklist draft added to /docs/model-onboarding/gating.md
Mike: I'll post comms draft in #marketing and ping Product.
Carol: If anyone sees backwards-compat issues, flag them here. Proceed with 60-day plan if no objections.
